title: Goodmayes (mock test)
learningObjective: A mock driving test round Goodmayes test centre: follow the examiner's directions for about ten minutes, driving as you would on test. Every fault is marked, as on the DVSA marking sheet; the result comes at the end.
briefing:
Goodmayes mock test

The examiner will ask you to follow the road ahead unless traffic signs direct you otherwise, and give you directions in good time: listen for them (they are shown on screen too; Task repeats the last one).

Check your mirrors and signal for every turn, keep to the speed limit and keep left. If you go a different way, that is fine: the examiner gives new directions. At the end you will be asked to pull up on the left.

Marking: driving, serious and dangerous faults under the marking sheet's headings; up to 15 driving faults and no serious or dangerous fault is a pass. Nothing stops the test early: a collision is marked as a dangerous fault and you carry on (select reverse to back away if you need to). The report comes at the end.

Built from OpenStreetMap data; not an official test route. Draft marking, not reviewed by an examiner.
